title: Script GC linked value scan
summary: Recover the 0x4f2150 thiscall circular list scan and its conditional call to the GC marker. The global list sentinel is at +0x68, its next pointer at +0x78, and linked nodes carry a value pointer at +8 and next at +0x10.
test_description: Compare entire fixtures against the original for empty and multi-node lists, varied node and object marks, signed tags and shared objects. Check short-circuit cases with null pointers, and FS head restoration. The integration adapter invokes the accepted marker.
known_limits: The marker is an external integration dependency; tests use object type 11 to avoid its external jump table. Other marker types and recursive traversal are outside this scope.
Layouts and calling convention describe 32-bit objects; valid circular links and eligible value and object pointers are required. No matching-byte claim is made.
